thread:
emma (Design): dropping a new pass on the autoscale panel. main goals: make SLO slider meaning obvious, clarify min/max interaction, and avoid burying burst semantics. figma: https://redwood.design/file/autoscale-pass2 :eyes:

noah (PM): nice layout. two product asks: 1) show the effective max capacity when burst is applied (so users know upper bound), 2) call out whether burst is billed differently.

ravi (Frontend): doable. suggestion: show a secondary readout under the sliders: "Max (with burst): 8 GPUs". for billing, we can add a hover state that shows "Estimated cost per hour".

emma (Design): microcopy proposals: 
- SLO slider label: "Latency SLO (p95, ms)" with pill showing target value.
- Burst label: "Burst budget — temporary extra GPUs" (short)
We debated calling it "burst quota" vs "budget"; leaning budget.

olivia (A11y): accessibility notes: the SLO slider must expose a textual description for screen readers that includes current value and how it impacts autoscaling, e.g., "SLO target 250 ms — lowering target increases scale-up sensitivity". Also ensure the burst readout isn't only color-coded; add a visible "temp" badge and an aria-label describing billing.

noah (PM): good point. billing language should be conservative: "Temporary GPUs may incur higher per-minute billing. See docs." link to docs.

drew (SRE): backend nuance: burst allocation is capped globally per-org, so the UI should show when requested burst exceeds org headroom and a soft disable state with suggestion "reduce burst or request quota". we can return a flag in the route config for that state.

ravi (Frontend): UI pattern idea: when burst requested > headroom, show the burst chip with a warning outline + tooltip and add a small CTA "Request more". Keyboard users need to reach that CTA.

emma (Design): also thought about the min/max sticky text: currently we show "Min / Max" above the pair. propose switching to inline labeled readouts: "Min: 2 GPUs" and "Max: 6 GPUs (with burst 8)" so it's explicit.

olivia (A11y): prefer inline labels. ensure labels are programmatically associated with inputs (for/id). sliders should have aria-valuemin/valuemax and aria-valuetext that describes units. For reordering or pool selection, ensure aria-grabbed states for drag interactions and a keyboard fallback (move up/down buttons).

drew (SRE): another small ask: when users set min==max (fixed), we should show a small lock icon with tooltip: "Autoscaling disabled; to enable, increase max". telemetry shows many customers accidentally lock pools.

emma (Design): yep, i'll add the lock indicator and help text. also want to tweak the fallback pool wording: instead of "fallbacks", use "Failover pools" — sounds clearer?

noah (PM): "Failover" is fine but check with legal; doesn't imply SLA. maybe "Failover (fallback) pools" for initial rollout.

ravi (Frontend): implementation note: chips for pools will include an icon for pool type (reserved/preemptible), a short name, and a drag handle. keyboard reordering will be arrow + space pattern. i'll prototype the focus ring and announce messages using live region for reorder events.

olivia (A11y): live region announcements are perfect. also please ensure contrast ratios for the chip text and warning states meet AA. i'll run a quick audit once prototyped.

emma (Design): final microcopy bank for handoff (copy only): 
"Burst budget — temporary extra GPUs available during spikes. Temporary GPUs may incur different billing rates."
"Fixed pool size — min and max equal; autoscaling is disabled."
"Max (with burst) — the maximum GPUs that may be allocated including burst capacity."

noah (PM): handoff checklist:
- finalize copy (emma/noah)
- show "Max (with burst)" readout (ravi)
- lock icon for fixed pools (emma)
- headroom handling + CTA (drew/ravi)
- a11y hooks + keyboard reorder (olivia/ravi)

emma (Design): i'll update figma and tag you all. quick dev Q: ravi, can the chips support an optional secondary line for small-muted text like "preemptible"?

ravi (Frontend): yes, small text under the chip label is fine. i'll add it to the PR.

noah (PM): great. if there are no objections i'll create the tickets tonight. thanks! :pray:
